main_text.head: CAPUT II. De anno Herodis ultimo, seu emortuali.
main_text.p: §. 1.Demonstratâ duplici regni Herodis epochâ, deliberandum nunc porrò est de anno, quo vitæ simul ac imperio finem imposuit, ut eum inveniamus terminum, quem inassignando nativitatis Christi tempore transfilire haud licet. Hic rursus ad Josephum provocamus, qui Ant. libr. 17: 10. mortem Herodis describens rationes temporis in hunc morem definit. Ταῦτα πράξας, inquit, ἡμέρα πέμπτῃ μετ᾽ ὸ Ἀντίπατρον κτείνει τὸν υἱὸν, τελευτᾷ βασιλεύσας, μετ᾽ ὸ μὲν ἀνειλεῖ Ἀντίγονον, ἔτη τέσσαρα καὶ τριάκοντα· μετ᾽ ὸ ὑπὸ Ῥωμαίων ἀπεδείκτο[?], ἕπτα καὶ τριάκοντα. His actis, quinto die postquam Antipatrum filium occiderat, moritur; cum regnasset, postquam Antigonum sustulit, annos triginta quatuor; postquam vero à Romanis regnum obtinuit, septem & triginta. Hi anni, si ad utramque epocham adjiciantur, nos ducunt ad æræ Julianæ annum quadragesimum secundum aut tertium. Si enim annis 37 adjicias annos Julianos quinque ante creationem senatus elapsos, invenies annos 42. aut si annis 34 addas annos octo, efficient identidem annos 42. Ne quis verò putet hic mendum latitare in numeris, sciendum, eadem scribere Josephum de bello Iudaico libr. 1: 21. Μετὰ δὲ τὴν ἀνάιρεσιν τῶ παιδὸς, ὑπερβὰς πέντε ἡμέρας, τελευτᾷ, βασιλεύσας ἀφ᾽ ὃν μὲν ἀποκτείνας ἀντίγονον ἐκράτησε τῶν πραγμάτων ἔτη τέσσαρα καὶ τριάκοντα, ἀφ᾽ ἧν δὲ ὑπὸ Ῥωμαίων ἀπεδειχθη βασιλεὺς, ἑπτὰ καὶ τριάκοντα. Post interitum autem

page.notes: The initial D is a woodcut and is joined to the following word as "Demonstratâ". The Greek is copied from a small, worn print; accents and breathings in the Josephus quotations are uncertain, and the form ἀπεδείκτο is marked [?]. "senatus" for the expected "seculi" in "creationem senatus elapsos" is kept as printed and may be a printing error. The paragraph's last line "Post interitum" is in italics, and the catchword "autem" is at lower right.
